messages:
Tom (AE): Priya — quick check before we lock SOW: we need firm numbers for throughput, model choices, and a line-item cost that fits your $10k cap. can we confirm traffic profile?
Priya (Customer): thanks. POC objective: demonstrable intent routing for 5 vertical intents. success if routing precision > 90% on our eval. timeline 2 weeks. budget target $10k max.
Cassandra (SE): got it. traffic details? concurrency? typical prompt/completion sizes?
Priya (Customer): concurrent users ~ peak 300, steady 120. average prompt 120 tokens, answer 220 tokens. sessions ~ 8 requests over ~2 minutes.
Hugo (Infra): rough math: peak qps ~ (300 users * 8 requests)/(120s) ~ 20 qps peak. but bursts possible; plan for 40 qps headroom.
Cassandra (SE): tokens per request ~= 340. at 40 qps => 13,600 tokens/sec. if model throughput ~60k tps/GPU (quantized 13B-like), 1 GPU is fine for throughput, but latency targets matter.
Tom (AE): latency target? Priya?
Priya (Customer): p50 < 300ms, p95 < 900ms. user experience is important but accuracy > latency if tradeoff.
Hugo (Infra): to meet p95<900ms with minimal batching, recommend: 1x mid-tier GPU for baseline serving + 1x burst worker (short-lived) for peak spikes. configure max_batch_delay=4ms and max_batch_size=6. fallback routing to smaller-latency model if queue grows.
Ben (Finance): ballpark cost for infra: mid-GPU $2.8/hr, burst GPU $1.6/hr. assume 10 days of active testing (including smoke + ramp) ~ 240 hours total of mixed usage. estimate infra ~ (150h * 2.8) + (90h * 1.6) = $420 + $144 = $564? wait that's off, recalc.
Cassandra (SE): Ben, numbers should be: 150h * 2.8 = $420, 90h * 1.6 = $144 => $564 (this seems low, maybe our $/hr units are for cores not full instances). use conservative market rates: mid-GPU $20/hr, burst $12/hr. then infra = (150*20)+(90*12)=3000+1080=4080.
Ben (Finance): ok using conservative rates => infra $4,080. add engineering support (SE time, deployment) $2,200. logging/storage $200. managed platform fees $1,250. contingency $270. total = $8,000 approx. fits under $10k.
Priya (Customer): fine. would like an itemized SOW. also need security questionnaire answers before kickoff.
sec-bot: security checklist: please attach SOC2 summary, network access plan, and KMS key policy. respond within 72 hours to avoid delay.
Tom (AE): action items: Cassandra to produce runbook + batch settings; Hugo to provide instance types and deployment manifest; Ben to produce cost breakdown line items; sec-bot we'll attach answers. I'll draft SOW and send for signature.
Cassandra (SE): Ill build an eval harness: ingest 5k labeled prompts, run A/B on model variants (quant-13B vs 70B slow model) and produce per-intent precision/recall. will add synthetic burst tests.
Hugo (Infra): I'll include KV-caching for repeated queries and enable prefix-cache which should reduce token load by ~10% in our sim. also will configure auto-fallback to smaller-quant model for <120ms cold-start.
Priya (Customer): can we get a smoke deploy within 72 hours of SOW signed? need to show product team.
Tom (AE): yes — target smoke in 72h post-signature. will push SOW today.
Ben (Finance): I'll provision a temporary spend cap at $10k and monitor. ping me if we exceed.
Priya (Customer): great, thanks everyone. looking forward to kickoff.
Tom (AE): thanks all. I'll post SOW link and a short kickoff calendar invite in this channel. :white_check_mark:
